title: Machines that learn
subtitle: Final project in Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence track. Every project here trains a neural network from scratch - and most of them run right in your browser.

projects.title: Guess What I'm Drawing
projects.text: A convolutional network trained on Google's Quick Draw drawings recognizes 42 things while you draw them. Play against it in a 6-drawing game.

projects.title: Emotion Mirror
projects.text: A CNN reads the facial expression from your webcam and shows what it looks at.

projects.title: Self-Driving Car
projects.text: A car learns to drive around tracks it has never seen, with DQN and distance sensors.

projects.title: Smart Intersection
projects.text: One network counts cars in camera images, another runs the traffic light and cuts the waiting time.

projects.title: A Drone That Learned to Fly
projects.text: PPO controls two propellers continuously, through wind, gusts and heavy packages.

projects.title: Runner AI
projects.text: Race three networks in a 3D endless runner: one copied human players, one taught itself, one did both.

projects.title: Maze Pilot
projects.text: A spaceship teaches itself to fly through narrow 3D mazes, seen from the cockpit.
